notes: SOURCE: casino inside Level 5 owned by Entity 18; entered and left only by its front doors; TH in large red letters; ~5000 occupancy; roulettes, cards, dice, slots; chips bartered with the front desk; red $1, blue $5, yellow $10, green $20 (purple $50 RUMOURED, not built); winnings paid in chips; the trade-in value table (Almond Water 2 red, Deuclidators 1 blue, Memory Jars 4 red, Activated Charcoal 3 yellow/g, Scarabacks 6 red, Royal Rations 1 green per 1/4 lb, Babel Balm 4 yellow, Maiden's Ink 4 green); dim lights flashing periodically, game noise, blaring music, chips clinking, AC breeze, classy new carpet, fine alcohol; rigging and living cards are REPORTED/unproven (the game odds are ours and nothing asserts rigging); the bar run by The Barkeep with a large menu; staff partly human with casino parts; Louie Sulphur the manager; the Beast's card wager (never lost); open 16 h, closed 8 h. TESTIMONY used as flavour: free first drink at the grand opening, the Comedian on chip duty, the stage. ADAPTATION: layout (lobby with front desk and cashier's cage, sunk floor -0.6 m and promenade, the Beast's dais +0.6 m, stage, east mezzanine +4.2 m with the bar) is ours; TH appears over the lobby arch and over the hall entrance because the exterior front belongs to Level 5; materials repeat Level 5's damask/walnut/gilt/marble/crystal palette; the open/closed cycle is compressed to 1 hour = 1 minute; a one-time 'pocket barter' (5 red) lets a wanderer with nothing to trade play; game odds and payouts, the jackpot-driven wager invitation and the scripted loss are ours; food and drink heal a little. Seeded: slot cabinet colours and the opening-hours phase.
